Subject: SOC2 evidence request — Incident Response Plan + sample logs

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of our SOC2 readiness review we need to collect your Incident Response Plan and a small set of artifacts we can validate against the SIG questionnaire:

- Current Incident Response Plan (IRP) document / runbooks
- Recent redacted postmortem summary for any security incident in the last 12 months
- Sample auth logs and a short description of retention and access controls
- SIG/CAIQ crosswalk or index if available

Can you please share the IRP and a one-page summary for the most recent incident by EOD Tuesday (US PST)? Also let us know if you prefer a short walkthrough meeting (30m) for the artifacts.

John Patel (security@finera.com) and Asha Rao (asha.rao@finera.com) are cc'd.

Appreciate it —
Security Team
Finera

Hi John / Asha —

Per our plan, please find the package attached and a short summary below. If you'd like the walkthrough, we are available Wed 2026-07-14 09:30am PST (invite sent).

Package summary (attachments):
- redwood_irp_v2.pdf — Current Incident Response Plan (version 2.1). Includes escalation matrix, roles, and SIG-required attestations.
- sig_evidence_index.csv — Mapping of SIG/CAIQ controls to artifacts, with file names & notes.
- auth-logs-sample-20260712.zip — Redacted sample of auth logs (500 lines) demonstrating retention and access controls.

Short postmortem summary (June 2026 auth anomaly):
- Event: transient token validation spike that caused elevated auth errors for a small subset of requests. No customer data compromise identified.
- Detection: automated monitoring alerted, triggered SOC pager; investigation initiated within 9 minutes.
- Mitigation: throttling rule deployed and signature rotation for affected tokens; full roll-back patch within 3 hours.
- Lessons: improved alert thresholds and additional telemetry included in next sprint; IRP updated to add token-rotation checklist (see redwood_irp_v2.pdf changelog).

Links: Drive package — https://drive.redwood.com/Finera/SOC2/IRP-v2
HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.com/contacts/FIN-2391

Let me know if you need extraction in a different format or additional samples. We are happy to walk through the artifacts during the scheduled call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance Programs
